email.hintProject: Send or forward emails to this address: the subject becomes the task name and the body its description.
email.hintTask: Send or forward emails to this address: the subject and body are added to the end of the task description.
email.syntaxHint: In the subject you can use: date tomorrow 5pm, @label, p1–p3.
email.secretHint: Anyone who knows this address can add tasks. Create a new address if it leaks.
email.regenerateMessage: The current address stops receiving emails right away.
